public pure function map_parameter(Xt, knot, nc, degree, wrap_parameter) result(u)

Optionally wrap one spline parameter into its active interval. Disabled wrapping and invalid spline states leave the parameter unchanged. Wrapping maps into the half-open interval , where and . It changes parameter evaluation only; it does not alter the knot vector or assert periodic geometry closure.
